title: Knights of Guinevere Plushies
description: Replaces totems of undying with awesome Knights of Guinevere plushies! (cool)
body:
# Totems to KOG plushies!
![preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f39cac0b74e668477ab0bea6d4a838cc94a89363.png)

###  It's simple! 
Rename on anvil **totem of undying** to "**Guinevere**", "**Andi**", "**Frankie**", or........ "**Bald Frankie**"... because i thought that was funny..

⚠️ From 1.21.5 it is VANILLA FEATURE (!!!), no mods needed.

⚠️ This thing will NOT work with other similar totem-of-undying-renaming resource packs. Only the prioritized one will.
